s: The archon's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}). The archon can innately cast the following spells, requiring only verbal components:
The archon's weapon attacks are magical. When the archon hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d8} radiant damage (included in the attack).
The archon can't be compelled to act in a manner contrary to its nature or its understanding of justice.
The archon has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Though it appears as a humanoid creature riding a mount, an archon is a single being. The "rider" can't be dismounted, and no other means can separate the two portions of the archon's being short of its death.
The archon makes two attacks: one with its sword and one with its claws.
{@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage.
{@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) radiant damage.

s: The felidar's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 14}). The felidar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

If the felidar moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claws attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. If the target is {@condition prone}, the felidar can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.
The felidar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
The felidar's weapon attacks are magical.
The felidar makes two attacks with its claws.
{@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.
{@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

The felidar touches another creature with its horns. The target magically regains 11 ({@dice 2d8 + 2}) hit points. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target

The felidar magically teleports itself and up to three willing creatures it can see within 5 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the felidar is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.
The felidar makes one attack with its claws.
The felidar creates a shimmering magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the felidar's next turn.
The felidar magically regains 11 ({@dice 2d8 + 2}) hit points.
The kraken's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}). The kraken can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:
The kraken can breathe air and water.
The kraken makes two attacks: one with its claw and one with its tentacles.
{@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 6d6 + 9}) slashing damage.

{@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}30 ({@damage 6d6 + 9}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 17}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition restrained}.

The kraken hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within 500 feet of it. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking 54 ({@damage 12d8}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
